summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The PIMCO RAFI Dynamic Multi-Factor U.S. Equity ETF (MFUS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the RAFI Dynamic Multi-Factor U.S. index. The fund tracks an index of US companies that are selected and weighted by a combination of fundamental and technical factors. MFUS was launched on Aug 31, 2017 and is issued by PIMCO.

holdings.infoBox: MFUS is an equity ETF with a total of 924 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 2.25%, Intel at 2.08%, Johnson & Johnson at 1.89%, ExxonMobil Holdings at 1.65%, and Chevron at 1.49%.
